stopBitingApp.name: Stop Biting
stopBitingApp.description: On-device AI app that detects nail biting (onychophagia) in real time via webcam and triggers an alert. 100% private — no camera data leaves the device. Includes streak tracking and a science-backed habit-reversal library.

handsOffApp.name: Hands Off
handsOffApp.description: On-device desktop app that detects body-focused repetitive behaviors (nail biting, skin picking, hair pulling, brow/lash pulling, nose picking) via webcam and interrupts them with alerts. Data is processed locally.

mainEntity.name: Is Stop Biting or Hands Off more private?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both apps process the webcam feed entirely on your device using on-device AI. Neither transmits camera data to a server, so both are private by design. Stop Biting publishes a technical explainer of how its on-device MediaPipe/WebAssembly detection works; Hands Off states it is GDPR compliant and records no video.

mainEntity.name: Does Hands Off have a web version?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. As of June 2026, Hands Off is a downloadable Mac and Windows desktop app. Stop Biting additionally offers a no-install web app (PWA) that runs in the browser, which is useful on locked-down or work computers where you cannot install software.

mainEntity.name: Which is cheaper, Stop Biting or Hands Off?

acceptedAnswer.text: Their monthly prices are effectively the same (about 2.99 per month). Stop Biting also offers an annual plan at $29/year, roughly $2.42/month, which is about 19% cheaper over a year. Both include a 3-day free trial. Pricing as of June 2026.

mainEntity.name: Can either app detect skin picking or hair pulling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hands Off covers five body-focused repetitive behaviors: nail biting, skin picking, hair pulling, eyebrow/eyelash pulling, and nose picking. Stop Biting focuses specifically on nail biting. If you have multiple BFRBs, Hands Off covers more behaviors; if nail biting is your focus, Stop Biting is purpose-built for it.

mainEntity.name: Do both apps work on Windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Both Stop Biting and Hands Off support Windows and macOS. Only Stop Biting also runs in a web browser as a PWA.
